Title: The panel opens on Applications Lists with its sidebar item
Description: Verify the HR-MPSB Panel entry page
Pre-conditions: Signed in with an account that has the HR-MPSB Panel module
Test steps:
1. Open the user menu > Switch Module
2. Choose HR-MPSB Panel and click Switch Module
Expected results: The page /hRMPSBportal/applicant-info opens, titled 'Applications Lists - ZCMC Recruitment Portal', with the heading 'Applications Lists', the line 'Report on the documentary review' and one sidebar item 'Applications Lists'
Actual results: As expected. The switch takes several seconds
Notes: Playwright: hr-mpsb.spec.ts. Needs ADMIN_STORAGE_STATE. The account is switched to the HR-MPSB Panel module

Title: The Published Postings table has its columns, toolbar and Generate RDR button
Pre-conditions: Signed in with the HR-MPSB Panel module active
Expected results: A 'Published Postings' table with the columns Job Position, Place of Assignment, Applicants Count and Interview Date, a Search box, a filter button (count badge), a column manager button and a Generate RDR button
Notes: Playwright: hr-mpsb.spec.ts. Generate RDR is not clicked (it makes a report). Accessible names of the two icon buttons to confirm on the first run

Title: With no published postings the table shows an empty state
Pre-conditions: Signed in with the HR-MPSB Panel module active. The panel lists no postings
Expected results: 'No published job posts' and a Per page selector
Actual results: As expected on 2026-11-23. The panel was empty although ATTORNEY I is published on the public site
Notes: Playwright: hr-mpsb.spec.ts. Skips itself if the panel lists a posting. Ask the team whether the panel lists only postings with applications or interviews
